acceptanceCriteria.text: Verified packaged solo monster presets resolve every supported level and variant using actual config IDs.
Dialog compares selected heroes, allocated troops and total with the selected monster; updates on team, level, target and roster changes.
Warn immediately for a weaker complete squad and disclose partial or unknown power without claiming victory; stale search levels cannot drive the comparison.
Power and actual dialog regressions, typecheck and production build pass.

checkpointPayload.description: Apply verified hero and troop power calculations to solo monsters in the Monster dialog after team selection and level search. Preserve exact target config variants, show incomplete data explicitly, and warn without changing attack queue behavior. Reuse @doc/api/world-map-rpc-contracts.
checkpointPayload.implementationPlan: 1. Verify solo config, preset hero power and troop composition with existing hash-checked generator. 2. Package solo power and add shared selected-squad comparison using the exact allocated troops. 3. Render a reactive comparison and advisory warning in MonsterModal, guarded by matching searched level and selected target. 4. Add math and actual component regressions; run tests/typecheck/build, update docs and record decision impact.
checkpointPayload.title: Compare selected monster squad power and warn before dispatch
